title: MP5 stream record (ASR transcript segment or VDB corpus document)
description: Faithful JSON Schema transcription of MP5 contracts.py (transcript_schema, corpus_schema, check_events). Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (ts_start < ts_end, 0 < duration <= 30 s) and deployment allow-lists (ALLOWED_SOURCES, ALLOWED_LICENSES) stay in the executable contract layer (schema/contracts.py).

source_id.description: Must be in the deployment allow-list; MP5 used ['local_replay'].

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 instant. MP5 files carry naive local times that Spark reads as UTC (spark.sql.session.timeZone=UTC), so the offset is optional here.
